# Bundled browser dependencies

- Marked 18.1.3: official npm package `marked`, `lib/marked.umd.js`; MIT license in `marked/LICENSE`.
- Highlight.js 11.9.0: official npm package `@highlightjs/cdn-assets`, browser build and four themes; BSD-3-Clause license in `highlight/LICENSE`.
- Leaflet: existing package and license retained.

Browser assets are loaded from the local Flask server. No CDN request is required to initialize the chat interface.
